description: This file implements AES encryption and decryption classes using the mbedtls library, supporting multiple modes such as ECB, CBC, CFB8, CFB128, and OFB, with functions for key setup, encryption, and decryption.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class providing AES encryption functionalities supporting multiple modes.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class providing AES decryption functionalities supporting multiple modes.

methods.name: AESEncryption::Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for AES based on the provided key length and key data.

methods.name: AESEncryption::Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data of specified length using the configured AES mode.

methods.name: AESDecryption::Key
methods.description: Sets the decryption key for AES based on the provided key length and key data.

methods.name: AESDecryption::Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data of specified length using the configured AES mode.
